notes.title: Update 1.1.4
notes.content:
Made the spikes for little spikes instead of one big one
 Made the pause button clickable
 Been having issues with achievements, they are currently displayed on the steam page, but I am having difficulty getting the app to interact with them. I will try again, but this update will not have steam achievements.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0: 6/26/24
notes.content:
Removed yay sound effect
 Lightened deep purple background in world 3
 Improved contrast on game buttons
 Made teleport sound quieter
 Previous page button on the custom levels page now says “Previous” instead of “Back”
 Removed timer from regular gameplay (it is still present in challenge modes)
 Now only one star can be earned per level
 Made the floors on world 2 and the walls on world 4 dimmer
 Escape and backspace now pause the game
 Made tile size scale to each level
 Added steam achievements

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
- Fixed crash glitch for users having issues with the controller manager
- Added MSAA 16 by default to fix artifacting for intel GPUs

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
-Fixed level skip in level 5-10
-Locked FPS at 60, should help with openGL issues
